preconditions.description: All characters in the input string are uppercase.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() for c in input)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string are either alphabetic or digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(int(word.replace('O', '0').replace('S', '5'), 16) for word in input.split() if all(c in '0123456789ABCDEF' for c in word.replace('O', '0').replace('S', '5')))
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of all valid hexadecimal numbers formed by replacing 'O' with '0' and 'S' with '5' in each word of the input string.
